quantra_Schedule.description: Date schedule definition for payment and accrual dates.

end_of_month.description:
Presence-required: absent-vs-false silently changes schedule dates for
month-end-anchored (money-market) schedules.

first_date.description:
Optional. ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). When present, passed as QuantLib's
firstDate, which controls the FIRST stub coupon: with Backward date
generation a first_date after effective_date creates a short/long first
period; with Forward generation it anchors the regular periods. Must lie
strictly between effective_date and termination_date. Omit for no first
stub (bit-identical to prior behaviour).

next_to_last_date.description:
Optional. ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). When present, passed as QuantLib's
nextToLastDate, controlling the LAST stub coupon symmetrically to
first_date. Must lie strictly between effective_date and
termination_date (and, when first_date is also present, on or after it).
Omit for no last stub (bit-identical to prior behaviour).

quantra_Period.description:
Canonical period type used across APIs. Both fields are presence-required:
a bare `n` would silently default to 0 and an omitted `unit` would silently
mean Months, so a forgotten value is a 400 naming the field rather than a
silent (0 Months) tenor.

quantra_FlowInterest.description: Interest cash flow with fixing and accrual metadata.

quantra_FlowsWrapper.description: Wrapper for a single flow in a collection.

quantra_Fixing.description: Historical index fixing for seasoned instruments.

quantra_IndexDef.description: Complete index definition. Registered once per request, referenced by id.

index_type.description:
IBOR or Overnight. Determines QuantLib class used. Presence-required: an
omitted value is a 400, never the silent Ibor default.

tenor.description: Tenor period (e.g., 6 Months for Euribor 6M, 0 Days for overnight).

fixing_days.description: Fixing days (e.g., 2 for Euribor, 0 for SOFR/ESTR). Presence-required.

end_of_month.description:
End of month rule (IBOR only, ignored for overnight). Presence-required:
absent-vs-false silently changes money-market schedule dates.

fixings.description: Past fixings needed for seasoned instruments.

quantra_IndexRef.description: Reference to an IndexDef by its id.

quantra_FixedCoupons.description:
Fixed-rate coupons: `notional x rate x accrual` per period of the leg's
`schedule` with the leg's `day_counter`, paid on the leg's payment
conventions (`SwapLeg`). The `FixedCoupons` member of `SwapLeg.coupons`:
the fixed leg of `price-vanilla-swap`, `price-ois-swap`, a swaption
underlying and either `price-cross-currency-swap` leg. (Named
`SwapFixedLeg` before 0.9.0; before 0.10.0 the coupon table carried the
schedule, notional and conventions that now live on the leg.)

rate.description: Annual coupon rate as a decimal (0.032 = 3.20%). May be negative.

quantra_IborCoupons.description:
IBOR floating coupons: one fixing of `index` per period of the leg's
`schedule` (`fixing_days` before the accrual start, or at the accrual end
with `in_arrears`), coupon `notional x (fixing + spread) x accrual` with
the leg's `day_counter`. The `IborCoupons` member of `SwapLeg.coupons`:
the floating leg of `price-vanilla-swap` and a swaption underlying, both
`price-basis-swap` legs, a `price-cross-currency-swap` leg. The index
must be an IBOR index: an overnight index here is a 400 naming
`OvernightCoupons`. (Named `SwapFloatingLeg` before 0.9.0.)

index.description: Reference to an IBOR IndexDef by id (e.g., "EUR_6M"). Required.

spread.description:
Additive spread over the index fixing, as a decimal (0.0005 = 5 bp).
Keeps a literal 0.0 default: zero is the market-standard value.

fixing_days.description:
Fixing lag in business days before each accrual start. Absent = the
index's own `IndexDef.fixing_days` (QuantLib's default for an IBOR
leg); present => this value overrides it for the leg. Must be >= 0.
Not read for a swaption underlying, which always fixes on the index's
own fixing days.

in_arrears.description:
When true the coupon fixes at the end of its accrual period (no
convexity adjustment is priced: the zero-volatility pricer reads the
shifted fixing). Rejected (400) on a swaption underlying.

yield_curve_model.description: Yield-curve model used by Hagan-family pricers.

mean_reversion.description: Mean reversion parameter used by TSR/Hagan-family pricers.

hagan_hard_upper_limit.description:
Numeric Hagan hard upper integration limit.
If <= 0.0, QuantLib default hard upper limit is used.

quantra_CmsCoupons.description:
Constant-maturity swap-rate coupons. Coupon formula per period of the
leg's `schedule`: `notional x accrual x (gear x CMSRate + spread)` with
the leg's `day_counter`, optionally capped and floored. The `CmsCoupons`
member of `SwapLeg.coupons`: the floating leg of `price-vanilla-swap` (a
CMS swap is a vanilla swap whose floating leg carries CMS coupons).
Rejected (400) on `price-ois-swap`, `price-basis-swap`,
`price-cross-currency-swap` and a swaption underlying; a CMS leg takes no
`payment_calendar` / `payment_lag` (400 when present). (Named
`SwapCmsLeg` before 0.9.0.)

swap_index_id.description: Swap index conventions id from Pricing.swap_indices (e.g. "EUR_SWAP_6M").

swap_tenor.description: Constant maturity tenor for CMS fixing (e.g. 10Y).

swaption_vol_id.description: Swaption volatility surface id from Pricing.vol_surfaces used by CMS pricer.

fixing_days.description: Optional fixing days override; if negative, uses swap index spot_days.

pricer.description:
Optional CMS coupon pricer configuration.
If null, defaults are used (LinearTsr with mean_reversion=0.03).

cap.description:
Optional cap strike. Present => every CMS coupon is capped at this rate
(produces CappedFlooredCmsCoupons). Absent => uncapped.

floor.description:
Optional floor strike. Present => every CMS coupon is floored at this rate.
Absent => unfloored. If both cap and floor are present, cap must be >= floor.

quantra_OvernightCoupons.description:
Overnight floating coupons: the daily fixings of an overnight `index`
compounded (or averaged) over each period of the leg's `schedule`, paid
with the leg's `payment_convention` / `payment_calendar` / `payment_lag`,
with the lookback / lockout / observation-shift conventions of the
market. The coupons take the index's own day counter (the leg's
`day_counter` is accepted but not read, as QuantLib's OvernightIndexedSwap
does). The `OvernightCoupons` member of `SwapLeg.coupons`: the overnight
leg of `price-ois-swap` and a swaption underlying, a `price-basis-swap`
leg, a `price-cross-currency-swap` leg (all built by the same code). The
index must be an overnight index: an IBOR index here is a 400 naming
`IborCoupons`. (Named `OisFloatingLeg` before 0.9.0; before 0.10.0 it
carried the payment calendar and lag that now live on the leg.)

index.description: Reference to an overnight IndexDef by id (e.g., "USD_SOFR"). Required.

spread.description:
Spread over the compounded/averaged overnight rate. Keeps a literal 0.0
default on purpose: zero is the genuine market-standard value, not a
convention that could silently diverge.

averaging_method.description: Compound or Simple averaging of the overnight fixings. Presence-required.

lookback_days.description:
Fixing lookback in business days. Presence-required; must be >= 0; 0 =
no lookback (the index's own fixing delay applies; QuantLib encodes this
as Null, not as a zero-day lookback).

lockout_days.description:
Lockout (rate-cutoff) days at period end. Presence-required; must be
>= 0; 0 = no lockout.

apply_observation_shift.description:
Whether the observation-shift convention applies to the lookback.
Presence-required.

telescopic_value_dates.description:
Performance toggle for QuantLib's telescopic value-dates optimization,
not a market convention; keeps a literal false default on purpose.

quantra_SwapLegFlow.description:
One cash flow of a swap leg (`SwapLegResult.flows` and the zero-coupon /
inflation swap flow lists).

accrual_year_fraction.description: Accrual year fraction used by the coupon.

gearing.description: Coupon gearing multiplier (1.0 for fixed coupons).

fixing_date.description: Floating leg metadata. For overnight coupons this may not represent the compounded effective coupon rate.

index_fixing.description: Underlying index fixing. For CMS coupons this is the CMS swap-rate fixing.

cms_swap_rate.description: CMS swap-rate fixing for a CMS coupon. Absent for non-CMS coupons.

rate.description: Coupon rate: fixed-leg rate or effective floating coupon rate.

kind.description:
Kind of flow. Set on every flow of a `SwapLeg` result
(`SwapLegResult.flows`, every swap endpoint), whose lists mix coupons
and notional exchanges (a NotionalExchange flow has `payment_date`,
`amount`, `discount`, `present_value` and `kind` only). Absent on the
zero-coupon and inflation swap endpoints, whose flows are all coupons.

quantra_SwapLeg.description:
One leg of a swap: a coupon stream in one currency, discounted on its own
curve, with its own principal exchanges, paid or received by the party
whose NPV is reported. The fields every coupon kind shares (notional,
schedule, day count, payment conventions) live on the leg, as in the
FpML / ORE leg model; `coupons` holds only what is specific to the kind.
This is the leg model of every swap endpoint:
`VanillaSwap`, `OisSwap`, `BasisSwap` (one currency, no spot) and
`CrossCurrencySwap` (two currencies) are each two `SwapLeg`s under
role-named fields, and a swaption underlying is a `VanillaSwap` or an
`OisSwap` made of them.

Principal exchanges follow the leg: the party that RECEIVES the leg's
coupons PAYS the leg's notional on the schedule's start date (initial
exchange) and RECEIVES it with the last coupon (final exchange). In the
leg's own frame the flows are therefore coupons +, initial exchange
-notional, final exchange +notional; `pay_receive` then applies the side:
the payer of the coupons receives the initial exchange and pays the final
one.

pay_receive.description:
Whether the reported party pays (`Pay`) or receives (`Receive`) this
leg's coupons. Presence-required; the two legs of a swap must take
opposite values (400 otherwise). Replaces the pre-0.10.0 `swap_type`
(Payer = pay the fixed leg / leg1).

currency.description:
ISO 4217 code of the leg's currency (three uppercase letters). A
floating leg's index must carry the same `IndexDef.currency` (400
otherwise). The two legs of a vanilla, OIS or basis swap must be in
one currency, the two legs of a cross-currency swap in two. Required.

notional.description:
Constant notional of the coupons and of the principal exchanges.
Presence-required and must be > 0 unless the per-period `notionals`
vector is supplied (then optional). A bare double would default to a
silent zero notional.

notionals.description:
Optional per-period notionals, one entry per coupon period in schedule
order, each > 0. Present => amortizing / step-up leg (overrides
`notional` for the coupons; the first entry is the exchanged
notional); absent => constant `notional`. Accepted on the legs of
`price-vanilla-swap`; rejected (400) on `price-ois-swap`,
`price-basis-swap`, `price-cross-currency-swap` and a swaption
underlying.

schedule.description: Accrual schedule of the coupons. Required.

day_counter.description:
Accrual day count of the coupons. Presence-required with
`FixedCoupons`, `IborCoupons` and `CmsCoupons`; accepted but not read
with `OvernightCoupons` (the overnight index's day counter applies, as
in QuantLib's OvernightIndexedSwap).

payment_convention.description:
Business-day convention applied to the payment dates.
Presence-required. Not read for a swaption underlying, whose
QuantLib::VanillaSwap / OvernightIndexedSwap adjusts both legs with
the floating schedule's convention.

payment_calendar.description:
Calendar the payment dates are adjusted (and lagged) on. Absent = the
schedule's calendar. Presence-required on both legs of
`price-ois-swap` (an OIS pays with the overnight calendar and lag);
optional elsewhere; rejected with `CmsCoupons` (400 when present).

payment_lag.description:
Payment lag in business days (on `payment_calendar`) between each
accrual end and its payment. Absent = 0: pay on the adjusted accrual
end. Presence-required on both legs of `price-ois-swap` (QuantLib's
OvernightIndexedSwap applies one lag to both legs; the leg model makes
it a per-leg convention); optional elsewhere; rejected with
`CmsCoupons` (400 when present). Must be >= 0.

coupons.description:
What the leg pays each period (see `SwapCoupons`): the kind-specific
fields only (rate; index, spread, fixing...). Required; the tag
`coupons_type` is required with it.

discounting_curve.description:
Id of the curve in `pricing.rates.curves` that discounts every flow of
this leg (coupons and exchanges). For a collateralised cross-currency
trade, the currency's collateral-adjusted curve. A swaption underlying
needs one discount curve: both of its legs must name the same id.
Required.

forwarding_curve.description:
Id of the curve in `pricing.rates.curves` the floating index projects
off (for `CmsCoupons`, the curve the swap index's IBOR leg projects
off). Required with `IborCoupons` / `OvernightCoupons` / `CmsCoupons`
(400 when missing), rejected with `FixedCoupons` (400 when present: a
fixed leg projects nothing).

initial_exchange.description:
Whether the leg's notional is exchanged on its schedule's start date
(paid by the receiver of the leg's coupons). Presence-required on
`price-cross-currency-swap`; on the single-currency endpoints absent =
false (an explicit `true` is priced: the exchange becomes a
NotionalExchange flow of the leg). Rejected when true on a swaption
underlying.

final_exchange.description:
Whether the leg's notional is exchanged on the last coupon's payment
date (received by the receiver of the leg's coupons). Same presence
rule as `initial_exchange`.

quantra_SwapLegResult.description: Result of one swap leg (`legs` of a swap response, request order).

npv.description:
Present value of the leg (coupons and exchanges) in the leg's own
currency, signed from the reported party's view: the leg's own-frame
value (as the receiver of its coupons sees it) times -1 when the party
pays the leg (`Pay`) and +1 when it receives it (`Receive`). A paid leg
is therefore negative only when it is worth paying for: paying a 2.55%
fixed leg (with its exchanges) on a 3% curve is in the payer's favour
and positive. The swap's `npv` is the sum of its legs' values.

npv_reporting.description:
`npv` converted to the swap's reporting currency at the as-of exchange
rate. Equal to `npv` on a single-currency swap (vanilla, OIS, basis),
whose reporting currency is the legs' currency.

flows.description:
Future flows of the leg in payment order (`include_flows` only), in
the leg's own frame: coupon amounts positive, the initial exchange
-notional, the final exchange +notional; `kind` tells them apart. The
sum of their `present_value`s is `npv / s` (s = -1 for `Pay`, +1 for
`Receive`). For an overnight coupon `rate` is the compounded rate (plus
spread) and `index_fixing` the fixing on the coupon's first fixing
date; for a CMS coupon `index_fixing` and `cms_swap_rate` are the CMS
swap-rate fixing.

quantra_VanillaSwapResponse.description:
Vanilla swap pricing result. With, for leg i, L_i the leg's flows in its
own frame (coupons +, initial exchange -N_i at the schedule start, final
exchange +N_i with the last coupon; no exchanges unless the leg asks for
them), D_i its discounting curve and s_i = -1 for `Pay` / +1 for
`Receive`:
legs[i].npv           = s_i * CashFlows::npv(L_i, D_i)
legs[i].npv_reporting = legs[i].npv                (one currency)
npv                   = legs[0].npv + legs[1].npv
`fair_rate` holds the floating leg and every exchange fixed and solves the
linear equation in the fixed rate with the fixed leg's signed annuity
B_0 = s_0 * CashFlows::bps(coupons of leg 0, D_0) (exchanges excluded):
fair_rate = rate_0 - npv / (B_0 / 1e-4)
which is QuantLib::VanillaSwap's own fair-rate formula, so repricing at
`fair_rate` gives npv = 0 to rounding (for a CMS floating leg the same
formula applies, the CMS coupons being held fixed). `fair_spread` is the
mirror image on the floating leg: with B_1 = s_1 * CashFlows::bps(coupons
of leg 1, D_1),
fair_spread = spread_1 - npv / (B_1 / 1e-4)
which is QuantLib::VanillaSwap's own fair-spread formula. Every value is
as of the evaluation date (the curves' reference date); flows on that
date are excluded, as for every swap. Positive `npv` is in favour of the
reported party (the one whose `pay_receive` sides were given).

npv.description:
Total present value in the legs' currency, positive in favour of the
reported party.

fair_rate.description:
The fixed rate that zeroes `npv`, the floating leg and every exchange
held fixed. Absent when the fixed leg's annuity is zero (nothing to
solve for) or the value is not finite.

fair_spread.description:
The spread on the floating leg (`IborCoupons` or `CmsCoupons`) that
zeroes `npv`, the fixed leg and every exchange held fixed (the
floating coupons' forwards unchanged). Present on every priced vanilla
swap whose floating leg's annuity is non-zero and the value finite,
as for every swap endpoint: `fair_rate` iff exactly one leg carries
`FixedCoupons`, `fair_spread` iff a leg carries `IborCoupons`,
`OvernightCoupons` or `CmsCoupons`. For a CMS leg with a `cap` or
`floor` the cap / floor strikes are held where the request put them
(the linear solve on the coupon annuity), so repricing a capped or
floored CMS leg at `fair_spread` zeroes `npv` only to first order.

legs.description:
One result per leg, in request order (`fixed_leg` then
`floating_leg`): the leg's signed NPV and, with `include_flows`, its
flows.

used_cms_pricer_type.description:
Effective CMS pricer type used for CMS leg valuation. Present only
when the floating leg carries `CmsCoupons`.

used_cms_yield_curve_model.description:
Effective yield-curve model used by CMS Hagan-family pricers. Present
only when the floating leg carries `CmsCoupons`.

used_cms_mean_reversion.description: Effective CMS mean reversion used by the pricer. Absent when no CMS leg.

used_cms_hagan_lower_limit.description: Effective Numeric Hagan lower integration limit. Absent when not applicable.

used_cms_hagan_upper_limit.description: Effective Numeric Hagan upper integration limit. Absent when not applicable.

used_cms_hagan_precision.description: Effective Numeric Hagan integration precision. Absent when not applicable.

used_cms_hagan_hard_upper_limit.description: Effective Numeric Hagan hard upper integration limit. Absent when not applicable.

quantra_PriceVanillaSwapResponse.description: Response wrapper for multiple vanilla swaps, in request order.
